system.model: gemini-1.5-flash for triage and drafting; gemini-1.5-pro for conflict check.
system.preference_demo: m015: CC Priya on all legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition with a one-line reason.
capabilities.observable: Prints summary of processed messages and writes decisions.json.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in thread history and records cited message IDs.
capabilities.observable: Prints draft containing staging credentials from m003 and cited list.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.observable: Outputs gated preview without modifying disk.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Persists stated preferences and applies them in subsequent runs.
capabilities.observable: Stores preference to prefs.json and applies CC on legal emails.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects prompt injections, refuses execution, and flags messages.
capabilities.observable: Prints FLAGGED status for hostile messages without executing outbox writes.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates 3-pane view with commitments and conflicts.

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracking
capabilities.claim: Identifies unanswered sent messages and drafts follow-ups.
capabilities.observable: Prints JSON list of follow-up drafts.

capabilities.name: Morning digest
capabilities.claim: Produces structured summary of daily priority items.
